name: Topic input enforces 100 character limit
description: Verify the input field limits text to 100 characters and shows counter

planSteps.description: Click the topic input field and type a long string of 50 characters
The character counter below the input shows '50/100 文字'
Continue typing until reaching near 100 characters
The input field has a maxlength attribute preventing more than 100 characters
The submit button remains enabled when text is present
